title: Hooked On Branson Fishing Guide Service
specs: Trips on Table Rock Lake, Lake Taneycomo, and Bull Shoals Lake
Captains are Coast Guard Operator of Uninspected Passenger Vessels Licensed (OUPV Six Pack), fully insured, and CPR certified
All clients are required to get their Missouri fishing license prior to their trip
Trout fishing trips require a Trout Permit with your license
Clients fishing on Bull Shoals Lake need a White River Border Lake permit
